build_dinov3_detector: build a DINOv3 ViT-7B object detector with pretrained COCO2017 weights using dinov3_vit7b16_de
run_object_detection: run object detection on a list of normalized image tensors using DetectorWithProcessor forward pass
create_detector_with_processor: create a DetectorWithProcessor module wrapping a DETR detector and PostProcess postprocessor for inference
build_custom_detector: build a custom DINOv3 detector with a specified backbone and detection head config via _make_dinov3_detector
review_detection_weights_enum: review the DetectionWeights enum to see available pretrained detection weight options like COCO2017
